# Files in the directories that get a license header (tools/apply-spdx-headers.py) which must not have one.
#
# One entry per line: <path or glob> <reason>. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored. An entry that
# matches no file is an error, so the list cannot go stale. Files that say "Generated by wayland-scanner" in their
# first lines (compositor/xdg-shell-protocol.h, the files in tools/build/) are skipped without an entry here: they
# carry the notice of the Wayland authors and are listed in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.
compositor/dosplex-compositor.c_revert                    stray fragment of compositor code that is not built or shipped; the owner may delete it
packaging/steamos/usr/local/bin/dosplex-compositor        compiled program, not source
tools/build/dosplex-keyprobe                              compiled program (built from tools/dosplex-keyprobe.c), not source
packaging/release-build/patches/*.patch                  patches to third-party sources the release build compiles (sources.json "patches"); a diff of MIT code carries no header of its own, its description is its first lines
packaging/release-build/texts/*/*                        license texts of packages that install none, copied unchanged from the package's source archive (assemble.py RECIPE_TEXTS); they ship in a release's licenses folder
compositor/subprojects/packagefiles/*.patch              the same patches, copied for meson's wrap of the development build (tests/release-sources-test.py keeps them equal)
tools/steam/*.template.vdf                              steamcmd build-script templates (Valve KeyValues text); they carry a PREPARATORY banner, and build-depot.py render strips their comment lines before steamcmd reads them
